FaqSection.subtitle: The most common doubts about the System Kyron ecosystem.

items.question: How do you guarantee tax compliance?
items.answer: We monitor the Official Gazette using regulatory vigilance algorithms. 16% VAT, 3% IGTF, and ISLR are automatically calculated according to current VEN-NIF regulations.

items.question: Can I manage several companies?
items.answer: Yes. The Partners Portal allows consolidating the accounting of multiple entities into a unified Command Center.

items.question: How does the BCV rate work?
items.answer: The system syncs every hour with the Central Bank of Venezuela API to ensure that all invoices and budgets use the official rate.
